description: This file defines the QuickSearchDefaults class, which provides default configurations and utility methods for setting up quick search features within a SuiteCRM or SugarCRM project. It includes methods to generate search parameter arrays for different modules, load related objects, and include necessary scripts.

classes.name: QuickSearchDefaults
classes.description: A class providing default configurations and utility functions for quick search features in SuiteCRM/SugarCRM.

methods.name: getQuickSearchDefaults
methods.description: Returns an instance of QuickSearchDefaults, optionally loading a custom class if it exists.

methods.name: setFormName
methods.description: Sets the form name used in quick search forms.

methods.name: getQSParent
methods.description: Generates quick search parameters for the parent module, default is Accounts.

methods.name: getQSAccount
methods.description: Creates quick search parameters for Accounts with optional billing and shipping address fields.

methods.name: getQSContact
methods.description: Provides quick search parameters for Contact names, considering locale formatting.

methods.name: getQSUser
methods.description: Produces quick search parameters to look up users.

methods.name: getQSCampaigns
methods.description: Generates quick search parameters for Campaigns.

methods.name: loadQSObject
methods.description: Loads quick search configuration for a related object based on module and relationship.

methods.name: getQSScripts
methods.description: Returns script tags required for quick search functionality, compatible with older versions.

methods.name: getQSScriptsNoServer
methods.description: Returns the same scripts as getQSScripts.

methods.name: getQSScriptsJSONAlreadyDefined
methods.description: Returns quick search scripts assuming JSON definitions are already loaded.
